name: nGZSceneGraph::NextSkinExtension
notes: Lane VS. A node's skin extension after `previous` (its first when null): the extension after previous (cIExtension slot 20 through the virtual base; none answers null without a search), then the node's FindExtension (slot 24) for 0x3ca0e8ab from there; the found extension's count released (slot 2) before it is returned, also when the search answers false. Mutants: the release only on a found search, the search without the next-extension check, the search starting from previous itself: all three killed.
